summary.zh: 平衡系点到枭兽形态，再从恢复系拿自然集中和自然主义，施法更不容易被打断，伤害再高 5%。
summary.en: Full Balance through Moonkin Form, then Nature's Focus and Naturalist from Restoration for fewer interruptions and 5% more damage.

scenario.zh: 60 级以枭兽形态打法术输出
scenario.en: Level 60 spell damage in Moonkin Form

pros.zh: 强化愤怒、强化星火术与日月之蚀加快两个主力法术：愤怒为后续星火术积累加速。
pros.en: Improved Wrath, Improved Starfire, and Eclipse speed up your two main nukes: Wrath charges faster Starfires.

pros.zh: 复仇让法术暴击伤害加成翻倍，自然之赐在暴击后加快接下来的施法。
pros.en: Vengeance doubles your spell critical strike bonus, and Nature's Grace speeds up the next casts after a crit.

pros.zh: 月怒提高 10% 奥术与自然伤害；枭兽形态提供护甲，并为队伍提高 3% 暴击几率。
pros.en: Moonfury adds 10% Arcane and Nature damage; Moonkin Form adds armor and 3% critical strike chance for your party.

pros.zh: 自然延伸增加射程和 4% 命中，月光让伤害法术的法力消耗降低 25%。
pros.en: Nature's Reach adds range and 4% hit chance, and Moonglow cuts the mana cost of your damage spells by 25%.

pros.zh: 经常被近战贴身？强化纠缠根须让纠缠根须不容易被伤害打断。
pros.en: Facing a lot of melee? Improved Entangling Roots keeps roots from breaking on damage.
